allowed_sentences: In a leave-one-facility-out test on the 193 rows of UKAEA's integro-differential validation table whose reaction was also measured at another facility, choosing each reaction's evaluation among TENDL-2025, TENDL-2023, TENDL-2017 and ENDF/B-VIII.1 by a fixed rule fitted on the other facilities gave ACTINV a median |ln(C/E)| of 0.139, against 0.160 with TENDL-2025 alone and 0.132 for FISPACT-II's published TENDL-2017 values; the choice brought ACTINV closer to the measurements than TENDL-2025 alone (p = 3e-05), and neither ACTINV nor FISPACT-II was significantly closer (p = 0.95).
The table's measurements had been compared with ACTINV's TENDL-2025 values before this test (P192); in each fold the held-out facility played no part in the choice.
